en: The front of the postcard features a hand-colored illustration of a European town square called 'Brunnenplatz'. There are classic 19th/early 20th-century buildings with balconies, a circular fountain/green area in the plaza, and several people in period dress, with one individual holding a red umbrella. On the left border, the postcard credits 'Ottmar Zieher München'. The bottom left has the caption 'Pyrmont.' The back of the postcard reads 'Postkarte' in a classic German font, with lines for address and a blue stamp for 'MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT'.
